architecture: Byte-level BPE + 3-5 gram TF-IDF + MultinomialNB and SGD (modified Huber) soft vote [0.43, 0.57]
training_data: CS747data.csv, own stratified 80/10/10 split (seed 747); not the repository's frozen split
leakage_warning: Most repository test/unseen_test essays were in this model's training data; standardized scores are optimistic.
original_submission_settings_verified: Model definition and tokenizer/TF-IDF settings taken unchanged from the authors' code; training data and tokenizer-fit partition adapted.
